in_hebrew.name: ננסי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word 'nanach' meaning 'to bestow, to give graciously'. It is a feminine form of the name 'Nathan', which means 'given' or 'granted'. Nanci may represent the grace and God in one's life.

in_greek.name: Ναγκί
in_greek.long_meaning: Nanci does not have a direct Greek counterpart. It is a modern name of Western origin.

in_latin.name: Nancieta
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin derivative of the name 'Nanci', meaning 'graceful' or 'gracious'. This name may reflect the grace and favor of God in one's life.
